artifact: Engine B verification -- reports/AMENDMENT_FLOOR_SPEC.md section 5 (B1-B6); verification only, never verdict-bearing

declared_before_run.per_bin_criterion: FROZEN text implemented verbatim: a bin passes iff |B - A| <= 1e-9*|A| OR |B - A| <= 10*ulp(A). The 10-ulp branch is the declared tighter bound (10 ulp <= 2.3e-15 relative < 1e-9 relative for normal-range float64 values); both branch censuses are reported per bin. Measured in the pilot: engine A's own float64 quadrature noise floor is ~1e2-1e3 ulp (cv) and ~2e2 ulp (tgt), so the frozen OR is met via the relative branch.
declared_before_run.chart_L_edge_cluster_treatment: pre-declared (see pilot findings note): a cv bin failing the frozen OR is excused only if covered by enumerated fine-bin membership disagreements with |bin_A-bin_B| = 1, |D_B-edge_exact| <= 1e-9, |D_A-edge_float| <= 1e-9, <= 100 members per cell, and max |delta cv| over OR-failing bins <= 1e-2 (mechanism-derived bound); tgt bins are never excused; uncovered OR failures -> STOP
declared_before_run.counts_criterion: k_GUE and k_Pois (plus captured gue-lower / pois-upper tails) must agree EXACTLY with engine A; any larger discrepancy -> STOP, record divergence, publish nothing
declared_before_run.b3_d_e: recomputed in exact decimal arithmetic at artifact precision; PASS = |sum - ref| <= storage-rounding budget (1 ulp60 per stored value + 1 ulp60 of the reference + 1e-300 relative margin); the original 1e-300 full-precision threshold cannot be re-established from 60 stored digits (declared limitation)
declared_before_run.scope: observed grid 18 cells per-bin; counts GUE+Poisson all 18 cells; GOE curves not recomputed (reported-only in engine A; declared limitation)
